items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: So I went to Pittsburgh with Billy Page's orchestra. I worked with him there a short while.

ctx.x: In 1925, there was a band that came to New York called the Broadway Syncopators -- that was Billy Page -- and they played at a place called the Capitol -- it was Capitol something, but it was a big cabaret in New York, a nightclub, and I think they had a saxophone player
with them named Vance Dixon, who had a fine reputation -- a very, very fine clarinetist and saxophonist. And he left and I was hard to replace the band there -- I replaced the Alto player.
